prompt: Why has Anya not told the person who wrote in whose name is on the parcel?
promptZh: 安雅為什麼沒告訴來信的人，包裹上寫著誰的名字？

options.text: The name is evidence that the parcel belongs to someone who has not written in.
options.zh: 標籤上的姓名證明包裹屬於尚未來信的人。
options.whyZh: 目前只知道有人詢問這種綁法的包裹，員工還不能據此判定來信者與標籤所列收件人的關係。

options.text: The details already on the public page are enough to verify the claim.
options.zh: 公開頁面上的資訊已足以確認失主。
options.whyZh: 棕色外包裝與藍繩已公開，任何看過招領資訊的人都能說出，不足以核對失主。

options.text: The incomplete address prevents staff from recording anything from the label.
options.zh: 地址不完整，因此員工不能記錄標籤上的任何資料。
options.whyZh: 流程恰好相反：未提供聯絡方式的外部標籤應列為員工紀錄中的辨識細節。

options.text: The name can help verify the claim only if the person supplies it independently.
options.zh: 來信者自行說出姓名，才能用這項資訊協助核對失主身分。
options.whyZh: 公開頁面只有包裹的外觀，沒有收件人姓名。員工不先透露姓名，才能核對來信者是否原本就知道這個未公開的細節。

explanationZh: 公開頁面只有包裹的外觀，沒有收件人姓名。員工不先透露姓名，才能核對來信者是否原本就知道這個未公開的細節。

vocabulary.note: 公開公告提供線索，但不會列出所有可用來驗證失主的細節。

evidence: Do not open sealed envelopes or parcels to look for a name. If an outside label names a recipient but does not give a way to contact them, record the label as an identifying detail in the staff record. On the public listing, describe the packaging without reproducing the name. A claimant may then supply the name without having read it on the listing. / The label on the sealed brown parcel gives a full name and a building number, but no street, phone number or email. I've only put ‘brown parcel with blue cord’ on the public page. Someone has written to ask whether we found a parcel tied that way. I have not told them whose name is on it.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Do not open sealed envelopes or parcels to look for a name. If an outside label names a recipient but does not give a way to contact them, record the label as an identifying detail in the staff record. On the public listing, describe the packaging without reproducing the name. A claimant may then supply the name without having read it on the listing.

The label on the sealed brown parcel gives a full name and a building number, but no street, phone number or email. I've only put ‘brown parcel with blue cord’ on the public page. Someone has written to ask whether we found a parcel tied that way. I have not told them whose name is on it.
